title: MustAtoi
hints: A `Must` helper is the mirror image of normal error handling: where you would `return 0, err`, you `panic(...)` instead.

`Must` is three lines: `if err != nil { panic(err) }` then `return n`. In `MustAtoi`, call `strconv.Atoi(s)` and panic with an error built by `fmt.Errorf` using `%q` for the input and `%w` for the strconv error.

`panic(fmt.Errorf("MustAtoi(%q): %w", s, err))`. `MustPort`: `n := MustAtoi(s)` (don't recover: its panic should pass through), then `if n < 1 || n > 65535 { panic(fmt.Errorf("MustPort(%q): %w", s, ErrPortRange)) }`.
